notes.title: Patch update 16/05/2017
notes.notes:
[h1] Patch update 16/05/2017 [/h1]

1. HTC Vive headset support. You can play Araya with HTC Vive Headset and keyboard/mouse or XBOX controller. 

2. Add Chinese subtitles.

Thank you for your patience and support, it means a lot to us and we aim to make ARAYA the best experience we can.

[h1] How to setup your HTC Vive [/h1]

1. Click VR button to open SteamVR 
[url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26677907/33d57db68a5c411696a6d547198ec6284299a988.jpg][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26677907/716471b5e32af2a6b1fe5ec5fb4a5e1f29e5ca3a.jpg[/img][/url]

2. Please wait until Vive is ready, click at he SteamVR menu.
[url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26677907/e66839700bcb4ea457b3bae95cdbd1fe5857f211.jpg][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26677907/c479f0bb6dac20c259127b85489823a581f035c7.jpg[/img][/url]


3. Select “Run Room Setup”
[url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26677907/9c08c6c24711a85aeb66bd94ac2a0ffb76ef5c28.jpg][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26677907/e984e502f19522b1b7a8ba0a8ade12df8572684f.jpg[/img][/url]

4. Choose “STANDING ONLY”
[url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26677907/0ab83994dafc6930b8bbf560812129ac88753d49.jpg][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26677907/0030e8d1318c3c6ec3f261394f5c2e06a29ef406.jpg[/img][/url]


5. Wait until Headset is ready, click Next.
[url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26677907/9944dce59516a44db79f7c5ee78503ea40f2aa64.jpg][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26677907/6a8d5f3ba935876d139b09f32bfec746ac63a47e.jpg[/img][/url]

6. Place the Headset at the center of your playing area.
[url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26677907/9944dce59516a44db79f7c5ee78503ea40f2aa64.jpg][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26677907/6a8d5f3ba935876d139b09f32bfec746ac63a47e.jpg[/img][/url]


7. We recommend to set Height value as 185 cm, then click “CALIBRATE FLOOR”.
[url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26677907/e1235d82adb7a8980691dde71f382a6ff88c12ae.jpg][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26677907/d137d16615618640c4db778e67c22d13553f0ce0.jpg[/img][/url]


8. Finally, click “DONE”
[url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26677907/2e6e2964f71d248a355e60a0d0283d5a9c3ada82.jpg][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26677907/38c9c2e5aeec7e9269dbc5a031f18b4e18cb5900.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Upcoming Patch
notes.notes:
Upcoming Patch

Hi everyone, It's been 2 months since ARAYA launched, we really appreciate your support. The next patch will be available in this February.

Patch will include:
+ Support for XBox controllers
+ Includes Y-Axis invert camera option
+ Includes Chapter selection menu
+ Fixes to the Achievement bugs
+ Fixes to several Graphical glitches

For HTC Vive, we are trying to maximize the benefit of using Vive controller.

Some game mechanics might be changed; eg. with opening the doors or picking up the item.

As HTC Vive support is still in the development phase, any input is welcome. 

We will let you know if there is any further updates.

Thank you for your patience and support, it means a lot to us and we aim to make ARAYA the best experience we can.

notes.title: Patch update 27/11/2016
notes.notes:
1. Improve the QTE system.
2. Fix rendering bugs
3. Fix bug audio clip that 
sometimes it does not play.
4. Fix various bugs.
5. Fix bug mouse position when playing in VR mode.
6. Fix bug player cannot earn Achievements.
Right now we are working on Gamepad controller support.

อัพเดท Patch ล่าสุดประจำวันที่ 27/11/2016
1. แก้ไขเรื่อง QTE ให้เข้าใจง่ายขึ้นว่ากดถูกหรือกดผิด
2. แก้ไขในส่วนของเรื่องภาพบัค
3. แก้ไขในส่วนของเสียงพูดที่บ้างครั้งขาดหาย
4. แก้ไขบัคเล็กๆน้อยตามที่ผู้เล่นรายงาน
5. แก้ไขเรื่องเมาส์เมื่อผู้เล่นต่อ Oculus
6. เพิ่มในส่วนของ Achievements

パッチアップデート2016年11月27日
1. QTE システムを改善する。
2. レンダリングバグを修正する。
3. 時々再生されないことがある 
オーディオクリップのバグを修正する。
4. さまざまなバグを修正する。
5. VR モードでプレイしているときのマウス位置のバグを修正する。
6. プレイヤーがアチーブメントを取得できないバグを修正する。
現在、ゲームパッドコントローラーサポートに取り組んでいます。

Patch-Update 27.11.2016
1. Verbesserung des QTE-Systems. 
2. Behebung von Render-Fehlern 
3. Behebung eines fehlerhaften Audioclips, der manchmal nicht abgespielt wurde. 
4. Behebung verschiedener Fehler. 
5. Behebung der fehlerhaften Mausposition beim Spielen im VR-Modus. 
6. Behebung des Fehlers, durch den der Spieler keine Erfolge verdienen konnte. 
Zur Zeit arbeiten wir an der Unterstützung für Gamepads. 

패치 업데이트 2016/11/27
1. QTE 시스템 향상. 
2. 렌더링 버그 수정 
3. 가끔씩 실행되지 않는 
오디오 클립 버그 수정. 
4. 다양한 버그 수정. 
5. VR 모드에서 플레이 시 마우스 위치 버그 수정. 
6. 업적 획득 불가 버그 수정. 
현재 저희는 게임패드 컨트롤러 지원과 관련하여 일하고 있습니다. 

Обновление 27.11.2016
1. Улучшение системы динамичных интерактивных сцен. 
2. Исправление ошибок визуализации 
3. Исправление ошибки аудиоклипа, 
который иногда не воспроизводится. 
4. Исправление различных ошибок. 
5. Исправление ошибки положения мыши при игре в режиме виртуальной реальности. 
6. Исправление ошибки, из-за которой игрок не мог зарабатывать достижения. 
В настоящий момент мы работаем над поддержкой управления джойстиком. 

补丁更新 27/11/2016
1. 改进QTE系统。
2. 修复渲染错误。
3. 修复间或不能播放的 
音频剪辑错误。
4. 修复各种错误。
5. 修复VR模式时的鼠标位置错误。
6. 修复玩家不能获得成就的错误。
现在我们正在开发游戏手柄控制器支持。

Actualización del parche 27/11/2016
1. Mejora del sistema QTE system. 
2. Arreglo de errores de renderización 
3. Arreglo de error de clip de audio que 
a veces no se reproduce. 
4. Arreglo de errores diversos. 
5. Arreglo de error de posición del mouse al reproducir en modo de realidad virtual. 
6. Arreglo de error por el cual el jugador no puede obtener Logros. 
En este momento estamos trabajando en la compatibilidad con el controlador de Gamepad.
